beats.line: angry rats heading straight toward the entrance of the dungeon
where they would come face to face with the chained prisoner
but to the unlucky prisoner they never actually saw anything at all
All they would hear in the pitch black were the soft scurries of rats' feet
entering the cell and within a matter of minutes those soft noises
were in the hundreds and they were all around him
these aggressive starving rats would then begin to take small bites from the prisoner
who had absolutely no way of defending himself. Now
you might be able to shake the rats off for a few hours but
eventually you would pass out from pure exhaustion
